title: Bolder hand: choose the visual world
question: Foreign forms, fused with Shigjetademy. The Term Shelf was dealt first; the Step Sequencer beat it on both axes. Pick one, or re-roll.

options.label: Term Shelf
options.lineage: A pickling-brine calendar: seasonal jars maturing on shelf lines
options.thesis: Every class is a glass jar on the term's shelf, labelled with start date, stage and day count, maturing from enrolment to report.
options.viewport: A long shelf across the viewport holds cohort jars at different stages; the headline is the shelf label; 'Book a demo' is a kraft tag.
options.risk: A food metaphor can feel whimsical to school directors unless every jar stays crisp.

raised.raise: Time bands stack in sync down the page, so every section shares the same term timeline.
One hub every section locks to, with a short bumper line announcing each section.
What happens next is always shown before it happens: next session, next invoice, next report.

options.label: Step Sequencer
options.lineage: An early-80s rhythm machine step row with a running chase light
options.thesis: The school day as a sixteen-step row: every period a key, a chase light marks now, lit keys are classes running.
options.viewport: A big headline above a panel whose sixteen step keys are today's periods; the chase light runs across while the dashboard updates attendance and payments; 'Book a demo' is the RUN key.
options.case: Beats the leader on both axes: every school runs on periods and bells, and a chase light makes scheduling and attendance instantly legible.
options.risk: If the hardware is overplayed it reads as a music toy instead of an operations platform.

options.label: Ray Poster
options.thesis: Rays fire from the arrow's origin; the page border is the term's dates, and the active date floods with colour.
options.viewport: A ray burst from the logo's arrow fills the hero; a border of term dates frames it and doubles as navigation.
options.case: Owns the arrow identity and makes the term calendar navigable, but its handmade clash undercuts 'premium'.
options.risk: Loud; can feel like an event poster rather than software.

options.label: Rain-night City
options.thesis: Campus windows light up as classes run.
options.case: Moody and indirect for a buying decision.
options.kept: Synchronized time bands stacked down the page.

options.label: Saturday Title Card
options.viewport: A bowed logotype on a starburst.
options.kept: One hub every section locks to, with bumper transitions.

options.label: Algorave Floor
options.thesis: Projected code that changes the room.
options.viewport: A code buffer at stage scale.
options.case: Educators don't identify with live code.
options.kept: Upcoming changes shown before they apply.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The clean SaaS homepage, like Deel's, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Centered headline, two buttons, a big dashboard screenshot below.
canonCard.risk: Hard to tell apart from other SaaS by design.
